_comment: Curated site content: the other Function Store products, and the one-line
pitch for each. Site-only — packaging/ never reads this. It lives here
rather than being typed twice because the same three cards appear on the
landing page and on /plus/, and two copies would drift.
Injected into the FAMILY markers on index.html and plus/index.html by
tools/build-site.mjs. `access` is the same vocabulary catalog.json uses:
what it costs to get the whole thing.

products.name: TDX Launcher Ultra
products.pitch: Find the project, get the build it needs, go. Global quick-launch palette, phone remote over QR, git and backup panels, and a companion COMP inside TouchDesigner.
products.access: Free core · Pro with a membership or a licence key

products.name: TDXMap
products.pitch: MIDI controller mapping without the wiring: multiple devices, banks, Smart Learn, button actions, 14-bit controls. Pro adds smoothing, pickup mode and easing curves.
products.access: 14-day Pro trial · Base and Pro with a membership or a licence key
